```{r}
# Load packages
library(tidyverse) # for {dplyr} functions
library(rio) # for importing data
library(here) # for easy file referencing
library(sf) # for shapefiles
library(lubridate) # to work with dates
library(survival)
```

# Raw Data
import data:
```{r}
## enrollment data (everyone)
# rn1 <- here::here("data", "RN1.csv") %>%
#   rio::import() %>% 
#   dplyr::as_tibble()
cohort <- here::here("data", "cohort.csv") %>% # entry/exit times
  rio::import() %>% 
  dplyr::as_tibble()
rn2 <- here::here("data", "RN2.csv") %>% # assign participant ID
  rio::import() %>% 
  dplyr::as_tibble()
so1 <- here::here("data", "SO1.csv") %>% # house demographics, etc
  rio::import() %>% 
  dplyr::as_tibble()

## clinical data (everyone)
arms <- here::here("data", "arms-blocks.csv") %>% # trial arm
  rio::import() %>% 
  dplyr::as_tibble()
# suspected <- here::here("data", "VA5.csv") %>% # suspected cases
#   rio::import() %>% 
#   dplyr::as_tibble()
actsurv <- here::here("data", "VAR6.csv") %>% # active surveillance results
  rio::import() %>% 
  dplyr::as_tibble()

## serology subset
sero <- here::here("data", "Serology Survey.csv") %>% # serology test results
  rio::import() %>% 
  dplyr::as_tibble()
```

merge prep:
```{r}
## merge....prep?
### give participants a unique ID
cohortp <- cohort %>% 
  select(-c(10:11)) %>% 
  mutate(record_id = as.numeric(str_sub(PPID, 1, 6)),
         Enrolm_Date = mdy(Enrolm_Date),
         Exit_Date = ifelse(E3_Date == "#N/A", "1/1/25", E3_Date),
         Exit_Date = mdy(Exit_Date)) %>% 
  relocate(record_id, .after = PPID)
rn2p <- rn2 %>% 
  # remove REDCap stuff
  select(-c(redcap_event_name, redcap_repeat_instrument,
            redcap_repeat_instance)) %>% 
  filter(!is.na(rn2_pt_id) & rn2_cnst_n2 == 1) %>% 
  mutate(PPID = paste0(record_id, LETTERS[rn2_pt_id])) %>% 
  relocate(PPID)
armsp <- arms %>% 
  select(-c(redcap_event_name, redcap_repeat_instrument,
            redcap_repeat_instance)) %>% 
  mutate(PPID = paste0(record_id, LETTERS[a_pt_id])) %>% 
  relocate(PPID)

### ok these also depend on year

### by house, not by participant
### so just get rid of redcap names

  select(-c(redcap_event_name, redcap_repeat_instrument, 
            redcap_repeat_instance))

## subset of main population, also for different endpoint (infection) ?

  select(-c(redcap_event_name, redcap_repeat_instrument,
            redcap_repeat_instance)) %>% 
  mutate(PPID = paste0(record_id, LETTERS[ss_pt_id])) %>% 
  relocate(PPID)
```

merge together:
```{r}
## big merge???
full <- cohortp %>% 
  full_join(actsp, by = c("PPID", "record_id")) %>% # event year + id + house
  relocate(c(Enrolm_Date, Exit_Date, evnt_year), .after = record_id) %>% 
  full_join(rn2p, by = c("PPID", "record_id")) %>% # id + house
  full_join(armsp, by = c("PPID", "record_id")) %>% 
  full_join(so1p, by = c("record_id")) %>% # house
  rename(Pos_All = var6_abv_pos___1,
         trial_arm = a_arm,
         block_type = a_block) %>% 
  relocate(c(Pos_All, trial_arm, block_type), .after = evnt_year)

# entry: beginning of peak ABD season (July 1 202X)? not enrollment date
# exit: date of symptom onset (var6_symp_date), 
#       or end of study period? (Dec 31 202X)
# indicator: var6_abv_pos - 1 yes, 0 and NA censored?
```

* considerations from original analysis
- limited to season (person-time only included july-dec?)
- within cluster center vs periphery (a_block; 1 central, 2 peripheral, 
  3 external)
- 25 second cases/recurrent events

cleaning???? how to organize dataset?
```{r}
# cleaning ? organizing merged dataset
full_org <- full %>%
  mutate(Pos_All = ifelse(is.na(Pos_All), 0, Pos_All)) %>%
  # each individual has an ID, house id, and year/season?
  crossing(event_year = c(2022, 2023, 2024)) %>%
  mutate(evnt_year = ifelse(is.na(evnt_year), NA_integer_,
                            ifelse(evnt_year == 
                                     event_year, evnt_year, NA_integer_)),
         Pos_All = ifelse(is.na(evnt_year), 0, Pos_All)) %>% 
  relocate(event_year, .before = evnt_year)
```
